description: Source code implementing UCI binding for switch configuration utility, including functions for applying configurations from UCI packages, managing switch settings, and interfacing with Linux kernel modules.

methods.name: swlib_match_name
methods.description: Checks if the given device matches the specified name or alias.

methods.name: swlib_map_settings
methods.description: Maps UCI section options to switch device attributes based on type and VLAN/port.

methods.name: swlib_apply_from_uci
methods.description: Main function to apply UCI package configurations to a switch device.
